title: Document
description:
A complete document: one theme applied to an ordered list of pages
on one paper.

outline.description:
The page titles of the complete document, in order. A preview
document lists more titles than it has pages: the app continues
it from this list later. Leave it empty when the document is
complete.

paper.description: The paper every page is laid out on. Absent means A4.

theme.description: Visual identity applied to every page.

title.description: Document title, shown on the first page and in the editor.

body.description: Family for every other text element that sets no font.

heading.description: Family for text elements with role `title` or `heading`.

Page.description:
One page: an HTML fragment for the document's paper, CSS for that
fragment, and author notes.

css.description:
CSS for this page only. The server scopes every selector to
this page. Use plain selectors such as `.title` or `h1`. Use the
theme through `var(--background)`, `var(--text)`, `var(--accent)`,
`var(--muted)`, `var(--heading-font)`, `var(--body-font)`,
`var(--mono-font)`. No `@import`, no viewport units, no `<`.

html.description:
The page as one HTML fragment. The canvas is the document's `paper` in px: 794 by 1123 for A4, 816 by 1056 for Letter. Use px units. Allowed: headings, text, lists, tables, `` with `src="/uploads/{name}"`, inline `
`,
`
`, ``. Not allowed: `

notes.description:
Author notes: intent, sources, or handoff remarks. Never rendered
on the page and never exported.

accent.description: Color for highlights, shapes, and chart series that set no color.

background.description: Screen background color when a screen sets no background.

muted.description: Secondary color for captions, rules, and table stripes.

text.description: Text color when an element sets no color.

Paper.description: The paper a document is laid out on.

Theme.description:
Default colors and fonts that elements inherit when they omit their
own.

name.description: Theme name shown in the editor.
